run_uninstall: run the Hermes Agent uninstaller with options for full uninstall or keeping user data
uninstall_gateway_service: uninstall the Hermes gateway service from systemd on Linux or launchd on macOS
remove_path_from_shell_configs: remove Hermes PATH entries from shell configuration files like .bashrc and .zshrc
remove_wrapper_script: remove the Hermes wrapper script from ~/.local/bin or /usr/local/bin
_uninstall_profile: uninstall a named Hermes profile by stopping its gateway, removing its alias, and wiping its data directory
